name: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3)
author: Darius Cumpio
announcement: Darius DB (Lite Version 0.1.3) — Faster Full-Stack Web & Database Manager! Now auto-detects PostgreSQL PGDMP custom dumps even when saved as .sql, includes parallel service detection, SQL connection pooling, instant table rendering, Import/Export & full CRUD, and visible auto-update reboot.
changelog: Fixed PostgreSQL custom-format dump import (auto-detects PGDMP/tar/dir dumps via pg_restore --no-owner --no-acl even when named .sql)
Fixed Auto-Updater visible reboot (--show --updated + ForceShowWindow + live main Setup binary priority) and improved Check Online build comparison

Performance Optimization: Parallel service status/adoption checks, SQL connection pooling, cached system MSSQL/PHP detection, zero-write settings checks, fast service readiness polling, debounced row filtering, and chunked Show All table rendering
Added Database Import (.sql, .csv, .bak) and Full CRUD (Create Row, Create Table, Show Details, Edit Row, Delete, Show All)
Added Single-Table, Selected-Tables, and Full-Database Export (.sql with Structure/Data toggles & .csv)
Added 1-Click GitHub System Updater with BuildID tracking, automatic update download, and automatic app restart
Added standalone DariusDB-Updater.exe and bundled Installer, Launcher, Uninstaller & Updater executables on GitHub
Fixed MySQL Error 1130 on 127.0.0.1, removed username/password from mssql.conf, and auto-provisioned sqlcmd.exe
Separated MariaDB and MySQL rows/tabs and redesigned Dashboard with Toggle-Switch rows & Full-Stack guide
Hardened PHP (Zend OPcache, PDO utf8mb4, secure sessions), Apache security headers, and MariaDB/MySQL InnoDB 256M configs
